transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because I keep feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. Like I’m failing at work, and even at home… like I’m a bad employee, a bad homeowner. Like maybe I deserve to lose what I worked for.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty often, even about things that you didn’t necessarily cause or control?

Yeah… I do. Even when it’s probably not really on me, I still end up feeling like I caused it somehow. Like if something goes wrong at work, or with the house, I just… I feel like I’m failing, like I deserve to lose what I’ve worked for.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this guilt been present most days, and have you felt like this for more than two years?

Yeah… most days, I think. It’s been a little over two years now — maybe two years and a few months. It started after I bought the townhouse, when the pressure of keeping up with everything started building.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with this guilt, like feeling hopeless, having low energy, or trouble enjoying things you used to like?

Yeah… I guess I don’t really enjoy much lately. I used to plan brunches, paint in the spare room, go hiking, sign up for networking events… things like that. Now they just feel like chores, like I’m pretending to care.
Do you often feel persistently worried or anxious about different areas of your life, like work, health, or other responsibilities, even when there isn’t a clear reason to be?
I’m… not really sure. I worry, yeah, but I don’t know if it’s like that, across everything. It’s hard to separate from just… normal stress, I guess.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried even when things seem to be going okay, or does your worry usually only come up when something specific happens?
I’m not sure. I think it’s more when there’s something specific going on… or when I think something might go wrong. I don’t know that I’m just anxious for no reason when things are actually okay.
Have you been feeling fatigued or noticed a loss of energy, even when you haven’t been doing anything physically or mentally taxing?
I don’t know… not in a way I’ve really tracked. I get tired sometimes, but I can’t say if it’s more than normal.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried when there isn’t anything specific happening, like when things are actually going fine?
I don’t think so… not really. If things are actually fine, I don’t usually notice myself worrying. At least, not that I can say clearly.

Do you ever feel anxious or worried about different parts of your life — like work, your health, or other responsibilities — even when you know, logically, that things are under control or not as bad as you fear?
I don’t really know. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, but I can’t tell if it’s like… across everything, or more just when something comes up. I don’t think I’ve noticed it that clearly.

Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things in your life — like work, your health, or other responsibilities — even when you know, deep down, that things aren't that bad or are actually under control?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I worry about a lot of different things all the time… or at least I haven’t noticed it that way. It’s hard for me to say.

Do you often feel anxious or worried about many different things in your life — like work, your health, or other responsibilities — even when you know those things are actually okay or not as bad as you fear?
I don’t think I can say that happens often. I mean… I get worried sometimes, sure, but not really about many different things when they’re okay. I haven’t noticed it like that.
Do you find that you worry a lot about different areas of your life, even small things, and that it's hard to control those worries even when you know they might not make sense?
I’m not sure. I don’t think it’s like… constant worrying about everything. Sometimes I get stuck on things, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s a lot of different areas or that I can’t control it.
Do you find that you often feel anxious or worried about many different things in your life, even when you know in your mind that those things are not really that bad or are actually under control?
I don’t really know. I mean, I do get anxious sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being about a lot of different things like that… or when things are actually under control.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about things even when you know in your mind that those situations are not actually that serious or are under control?
I’m not really sure. I mean, sometimes I worry, but I don’t know if it’s when things are actually under control… I haven’t really noticed it that way.
Do you often find yourself anxious or worried about your performance or outcomes at work, even when things are actually going fine or you know you're meeting expectations?

Yeah… at work, even if things seem fine, I still feel like people are watching for any mistake. Like they’re waiting to prove I’m irresponsible or something. It’s hard to just believe I’m meeting expectations.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about a variety of things in your life, even when you know in your mind that those things aren’t really that serious or are under control?
I don’t know… not really in a broad way. I worry about some things, but I haven’t really tracked whether it’s a bunch of different things or if they’re actually under control.
Do you ever feel anxious or on edge even when nothing specific is happening or things are actually going fine?
I’m not sure… maybe sometimes, but I don’t really think of it that way. I usually feel like there’s some reason, even if I can’t explain it clearly.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about your work performance even when you know, objectively, that you're meeting expectations or doing well?

Yeah… even when I know I’m doing okay, I still feel like people at work are watching for mistakes. Like if I mess up, they’ll use it to prove I’m irresponsible. It feels tied to the mortgage company too… like they’re looking for a reason to take the townhouse.
